summary: A quote packet followed by zero padding in one binary frame (issue #2502): the padding reads as a header shorter than itself, so the parse stops after the packet, which is published alone (web f83592a0b).

notes: Before web f83592a0b the web's parser never moved past the padding and its receive thread spun; the replay of this case needs the web at that commit or later.

deviations.reason: The web sends Dhan's trade time in epoch seconds as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends ltt in ms and Dhan's last_trade_time in seconds, as the web does.
deviations.ref: dhan_adapter.py:900; feed::dialect (Dhan last_trade_time in seconds, openalgo#2377)
